tasks.title: Import plan and establish progress tracking

tasks.title: Specify recipe and core/domain boundary
acceptance_criteria: Recipe outline and core/domain boundary are recorded; recipe schema versioning is explicit.

tasks.title: Specify baseline and review three tiny cases
acceptance_criteria: Baseline specification records eligibility, units, dose/date/tie handling, and independently established expected results for three tiny reviewed cases.

tasks.title: Evaluate environment, packaging, and UI
acceptance_criteria: Supported Python minor version and locked environment are selected.
Exact Windows/Linux/macOS targets including Apple silicon, reference benchmark hardware, and frozen workload are recorded.
Offline launch, keyboard-use, and packaging experiment informs UI and installer/signing choices; fresh checkout runs a meaningful smoke test.

First workbook experiment: both generic entry paths share one provisional configuration; fixed invented sample suggestions are distinguished from defaults and overrides; edits survive view switching and save/reload; counts distinguish 1,000 new from 10 retained plus 990 new; keyboard recovery, laptop layout, offline assets and exact tested environment are recorded. Maintainer UI review is required; this partial experiment does not adopt NiceGUI or complete the remaining environment/platform/benchmark/packaging criteria.

tasks.title: Establish contributor and release rules
acceptance_criteria: Concise contributor/release rules include real runnable setup/check commands when available.
Approved MIT license is present; complete dependency/license review before public alpha.

tasks.title: Apply Ravel branding and build the progress dashboard
acceptance_criteria: Current documentation uses Ravel, the agreed tagline and subtitle, and intended ravel names; PyPI remains unresolved and application features remain planned.

A standard-library generator creates a deterministic offline, read-only HTML snapshot with status counts, M0-M6 task criteria/blockers/evidence, search and filters, next action, project blockers, and all ten gates using plan criterion text.
Input validation, reference/status consistency, totals, escaping, deterministic output, external-resource isolation, and Git whitespace checks pass; browser checks are reported with limitations.
Actual generation/check commands and regeneration rules are documented; existing statuses and gate criteria are preserved; maintainer visual inspection passes and its result is recorded.

tasks.title: Show current focus and upcoming tasks first
acceptance_criteria: A compact focus panel immediately after a small Ravel heading shows the current milestone, current task and actual status, concrete next action, two upcoming tasks in recorded order, and relevant project/milestone/current-task blockers when present; current task and action are visible at normal laptop zoom, ahead of prominent branding and counts.

Minimal current_task_id and ordered next_task_ids metadata references existing tasks; titles, statuses and milestone are derived from records and next_action supplies action text. Validation rejects duplicate, unknown or completed selections, and documentation explains advancing focus after acceptance.
Task links reveal and expand details even when filters hide them and support keyboard navigation; existing filtering, task details, counts and release gates remain usable.

Offline deterministic generation, focused metadata/order checks, documented tracking tests, freshness and Git whitespace checks pass; browser layout and task navigation are inspected when available and limitations are reported.

tasks.title: Implement generic entry paths and optional clinical CLI slice
acceptance_criteria: The first usable slice supports both generic explicit-rule generation and basic single-table sample-assisted generation/extension through one recipe. Basic profiling proposes editable types, categories, missingness and ranges with provenance, excludes identifiers by default, and reports unsupported inputs. Both paths save/load and export; ten source rows produce exactly 1,000 new rows or extend to 1,000 total with 990 generated rows, preserved source values and row origins. The clinical template is optional and generic screens use general terms.
CLI generates the M1 subject, exposure, biomarker, and scheduled-visit slice with CSVs, recipe, dictionary, and validation output.
Reviewed numeric representation/range, overflow handling, rounding and export-format policies are required before clinical numeric implementation within the existing M1 slice.

tasks.title: Verify repeatability and actionable errors
acceptance_criteria: Repeat runs reproduce content; infeasible requests fail clearly without silent relaxation or partial success.
Stable entity/field random streams support independent-field addition.

tasks.title: Establish twelve cases and selected mappings
acceptance_criteria: All twelve specified cases have independently established expected results and valid/invalid classification.
Selected source-to-analysis mappings record exact standard versions and limitations.

Implement the specified clinical derivation outputs and declared negative-fixture export/validation contract for the twelve planned scenarios; establish reference expectations before implementing their derivations. This does not expand the M1 working slice.

tasks.title: Verify derivations independently in R
acceptance_criteria: R comparisons agree with expected results and targeted checks detect all specified wrong derivations.
One example table and figure are reproducible; unexecuted SAS companion work is labelled if present.
Document Python/R comparison tolerances consistent with the reviewed numeric policy and the plan's R3 cross-platform qualification.

tasks.title: Prepare reproducible public alpha
acceptance_criteria: Tagged alpha quickstart reproduces its declared scope with license, installation instructions, limitations, and checks ready.
The first usable alpha includes both M1 generic entry paths and their shared recipe; basic sample-assisted generation/extension is not deferred until M3.

tasks.title: Profile sample and edit assumptions
acceptance_criteria: Extend the basic sample-assisted path delivered in M1; this milestone owns deeper profiling and the full supported-assumption criteria, not the first availability of sample-assisted generation.
Invented CSV profiling exposes editable estimates, excludes identifiers by default, and reports unsupported fields and overrides.
Requested categories, quotas, missingness, ranges, and supported dependencies are explicit.

tasks.title: Verify both sample expansion workflows
acceptance_criteria: Generated-only and retain-and-extend pass R4 with retained values and row origins checked; uniqueness and infeasible requests are explicit.

tasks.title: Implement Guided and Advanced recipe views
acceptance_criteria: Both views share the engine and preserve canonical settings through switching, preview, save, and reload.

tasks.title: Verify accessible workflow and recovery
acceptance_criteria: Both principal workflows are keyboard-completable with labelled controls, readable errors, and invalid-input recovery.

tasks.title: Verify native offline installation bundles
acceptance_criteria: Clean-machine installation and offline generation pass on all selected platforms with explicit prerequisites, network observations, and bundle checksums.

tasks.title: Verify statistical, performance, and reproducibility gates
acceptance_criteria: Collect evidence for R3, R5, and R6 under their unchanged criteria in docs/plan.md, recording pinned environments and raw measurements.

tasks.title: Verify update and reinstall workflow
acceptance_criteria: Manual offline-capable update/reinstall instructions pass smoke checks; preceding-alpha recipes load or receive clear migration/error messages.

tasks.title: Run usability exercise and fix blockers
acceptance_criteria: Usability exercise meets R8; fixes are checked and no release-blocking defects remain.

tasks.title: Complete validation report and release
acceptance_criteria: Every R1–R10 gate has evidence against the release commit; supported-platform core checks and clean-checkout quickstart pass.
Concise documentation, limitations, license/dependency notices, tag, release notes, artifacts/checksums, and tested update instructions are ready.
